profile.name: NEHA
profile.tagline: I design the interfaces where intelligent systems and human needs meet — across every reality.
profile.bio: Neha is an AI, XR and UX designer who believes intelligence should feel less like a machine and more like a kind companion. She crafts spatial worlds, conversational minds and product surfaces where technology disappears and understanding arrives.

projects.title: Synapse Assistant
projects.subtitle: AI · Systems
projects.blurb: A grounded multimodal AI copilot — intent trees, memory layers and voice-first UX for enterprise workflows.
projects.description: Enterprise teams juggle fragmented tools and lose context. Synapse anchors every response to verified sources, with branching intent trees and persistent memory.

details.challenge: Enterprise teams juggle fragmented tools and lose context across tasks. Existing AI copilots hallucinate, lack memory, and fail at multi-step workflows.
details.approach: Designed a grounded multimodal copilot with intent trees for branching logic, persistent memory layers, and voice-first interaction. Every response is anchored to verified data sources.
details.result: Reduced task-switching friction by 40% in pilot. Teams reported higher trust and faster completion of complex multi-step workflows.

projects.title: Aether Field
projects.subtitle: XR · Immersive
projects.blurb: Hand-tracked AR workspace that projects live 3D data into the room. Gestures tuned for 45-minute sessions.
projects.description: Data analysts walk around datasets. Aether turns flat dashboards into a room you can enter and move through.

details.challenge: Data analysts lose insight when working with flat dashboards. Spatial data has depth and patterns that screens compress into 2D.
details.approach: Built a hand-tracked AR workspace where live data projects into the room. Designed spatial gestures calibrated for sustained 45-minute sessions without fatigue.
details.result: 28% faster pattern recognition vs screen dashboards. Analysts described it as walking through the data.

projects.title: Pulse Bank
projects.subtitle: UX · Research
projects.blurb: Fintech onboarding rebuild that lifted activation 31% through friction-first audit and expressive motion.
projects.description: A 68% drop-off flow rebuilt with progressive disclosure, motion feedback and micro-interactions that reward completion.

details.challenge: Pulse Bank onboarding had a 68% drop-off rate. Users felt lost and distrustful during verification and setup.
details.approach: Conducted a friction-first audit to map every decision point. Rebuilt the flow with progressive disclosure and expressive motion for progress.
details.result: Activation 32% → 63%. Time-to-first-transaction halved. Motion system became a trust case study in fintech.

projects.title: Orbit OS
projects.subtitle: Product · Systems
projects.blurb: A token-powered design OS that generates variant UIs from natural language briefs.
projects.description: Natural language briefs become shipped interfaces. Tokens describe intent; the system handles composition and adaptation.

details.challenge: Design teams spend weeks producing UI variants for A/B testing and localization. Each variant requires manual adaptation.
details.approach: Created a token-powered OS where briefs generate variant UIs. Tokens act as the control layer for intent while the system handles spatial composition.
details.result: Cut variant production from weeks to hours. Teams shipped 3x more variants, enabling rapid experimentation.

projects.title: Lumen Voice
projects.subtitle: AI · Voice
projects.blurb: A calm voice agent for healthcare triage — designed for trust in high-stakes, low-literacy contexts.
projects.description: When understanding matters more than speed. Lumen listens, clarifies and never pretends to be human.

details.challenge: Voice agents in healthcare feel robotic and erode trust when they overstate confidence.
details.approach: Designed uncertainty-aware dialogue with explicit grounding, slow cadence and kinship cues. Tested with low-literacy users across 3 languages.
details.result: Trust scores +34% vs baseline. Correct escalation 92%.

projects.title: Mira Spatial
projects.subtitle: XR · Retail
projects.blurb: Mixed-reality retail where shoppers place, resize and compare products at true scale before buying.
projects.description: Try before you buy at 1:1 scale. No headset fatigue, no gimmicks — just spatial confidence.

details.challenge: Online retail lacks spatial confidence. Returns spike when scale is misjudged.
details.approach: Built MR product placement with true-scale anchoring, shadow grounding and haptic-aligned gestures for comparison.
details.result: Return rate -22%. Session time +18% without fatigue.
